name: Ijou Chitai ~Kanojo wa Boku no Jikken Dorei~
original_name: 異常痴態 ～彼女は僕の実験奴隷～
source:
A shared toilet room with no bath. A shabby wooden 1 room apartment...
The main character is the sole inhabitant of that apartment, possessing a warped love.

Big breasted student landlord, Azami Imano.


Before too long the main character's feelings revolve around making the girl his own, becoming cross.

"I'm thinking of leaving this apartment....."

If the main character leaves there will be no residents, and Azami's beloved apartment will be taken away.

"P-.. please! I'll do anything, so please don't leave...!"

Azami will truly do anything to protect her apartment.
The main character's conditions for staying? Azami must let him do something foul to her...!

Taking a medicine, her breasts begin to leak and it becomes a milking play. Her clit swells. Vibe play. Group violation. Transformation into a hermaphrodite. Tentacles...
Things usually never thought of, abnormal and perverse play. Azami will have to give up both her heart and flesh....

translation:
共用卫生间，没有浴缸。一间破旧的木制一室公寓……
主角是这间公寓的唯一居民，拥有扭曲的爱情。

巨乳学生楼主，今野阿扎美。


不久之后，主角的感情就围绕着把女孩变成自己的，变得脾气暴躁。

“我正在考虑离开这个公寓……”

如果主角离开，这里就没有居民了，阿扎美心爱的公寓也将被夺走。

“拜、拜托！我会做任何事情，所以请不要离开……！”

阿扎米真的会不惜一切代价保护她的公寓。
主角的入住条件？阿扎美一定要让他对她做一些肮脏的事……！

吃药后，她的乳房开始漏水，变成了挤奶游戏。她的阴蒂肿胀。氛围演奏。集体违规。转变为雌雄同体。触手…
平时想不到的事情，变态、反常的发挥。阿扎美将不得不放弃她的心和肉体……
